meta.title: Enterprise Software Development | Anthovai - Intelligence, Engineered.
meta.description: Anthovai builds enterprise software that powers operations across healthcare, retail, and manufacturing — engineered for scale, compliance, and performance.

hero.intro: Anthovai builds enterprise software that powers operations across healthcare, retail, and manufacturing — engineered for scale, compliance, and performance.

whatIs.title: What is Enterprise Software?
whatIs.body: Enterprise software forms the digital backbone of large-scale organizations. It centralizes data, automates complex workflows, and integrates disparate systems into a unified operational platform.

p1.title: Precision Engineered
p1.desc: We build systems with exact tolerances, ensuring zero-downtime reliability.

p2.title: AI Native
p2.desc: Intelligence is built into the core architecture, not bolted on as an afterthought.

p3.title: Bespoke Architecture
p3.desc: No off-the-shelf compromises. Your system is designed specifically for your operational reality.

s1.title: Architecture Design
s1.desc: We map your entire operational lifecycle to identify redundancies and design the ideal system footprint.

s2.title: System Integration
s2.desc: We connect legacy databases, third-party APIs, and new microservices into a cohesive whole.

s3.title: Precision Development
s3.desc: Our engineers build the core platform using high-performance, strictly-typed languages.

s4.title: Deployment & Evolution
s4.desc: We deploy with zero-downtime strategies and continuously evolve the system based on real-world telemetry.

q1.q: What is the typical timeline for an enterprise software project?
q1.a: Timelines vary by complexity, but core architecture deployment usually takes 3 to 6 months. We prioritize rapid, iterative releases.

q2.q: Do you offer post-launch support and maintenance?
q2.a: Yes. We operate as your long-term engineering partner, providing continuous evolution, security patching, and scaling support.

q3.q: Can you integrate with our existing legacy systems?
q3.a: Absolutely. A core part of our expertise is building secure translation layers and APIs to connect legacy mainframes with modern infrastructure.

q4.a: You do. Upon completion, the source code, architecture blueprints, and all associated intellectual property are fully transferred to your organization.

meta.title: Healthcare Software Development | Anthovai
meta.description: Anthovai develops healthcare software systems that streamline clinical workflows and patient data management — built for PDPA compliance.

hero.h1: Healthcare Software Development — Clinical & Operational Systems
hero.intro: Anthovai develops healthcare software systems that streamline clinical workflows, patient data management, and hospital operations — built for PDPA compliance and HL7/FHIR integration.

s1.title: Patient Data & Records Systems
s1.desc: We engineer highly secure, encrypted electronic health record (EHR) systems that provide real-time patient history across departments without compromising access speed.

s2.title: Compliance: PDPA / HL7 / FHIR
s2.desc: Regulatory compliance is baked into our architecture. We ensure all data pipelines adhere strictly to PDPA privacy laws and international HL7/FHIR interoperability standards.

s3.title: Integration with Existing HIS
s3.desc: We do not disrupt your clinical workflows. Our software integrates seamlessly via secure APIs into your existing Hospital Information Systems (HIS).

q1.q: Are your healthcare systems HIPAA and PDPA compliant?
q1.a: Yes. Every system we build incorporates end-to-end encryption, strict role-based access control, and full audit logging to meet PDPA and HIPAA standards.

q2.q: Can you integrate AI into clinical diagnostics?
q2.a: We build the secure data pipelines that allow AI models to process imaging and lab results. However, we do not build medical diagnostic models ourselves.

q3.q: How do you handle patient data migration?
q3.a: We use zero-downtime ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes with multi-stage verification to ensure zero data loss during legacy migration.

q4.a: Yes. We develop secure patient portals for appointment scheduling, telemedicine, and lab result viewing.

meta.title: Retail & E-commerce Software | Anthovai
meta.description: Anthovai builds retail and e-commerce platforms that unify inventory, orders, and customer data across all channels.

hero.h1: Retail & E-commerce Software — Inventory, Orders, and Customer Systems
hero.intro: Anthovai builds retail and e-commerce platforms that unify inventory, orders, and customer data across all channels — scalable from single-store to enterprise-wide operations.

s1.title: Omnichannel Systems
s1.desc: We build platforms that synchronize your physical retail stores with your digital e-commerce presence in true real-time.

s2.title: POS & Payment Integration
s2.desc: Our systems connect directly to leading payment gateways and Point of Sale (POS) hardware, ensuring transaction integrity and speed.

s3.title: Scalability & Performance
s3.desc: Engineered for high-traffic events like Black Friday, our cloud-native architectures auto-scale to handle massive concurrent transaction volumes.

q1.q: Do you build custom e-commerce engines or use Shopify?
q1.a: We build fully custom, headless e-commerce engines for enterprises where standard platforms like Shopify cannot handle the required architectural complexity.

q2.a: We use event-driven architecture to update inventory databases globally the millisecond an item is purchased, preventing overselling.

q3.q: Can you integrate with our warehouse robots?
q3.a: Yes. We build APIs that communicate directly with Automated Storage and Retrieval Systems (ASRS) and warehouse management robots.

q4.a: We integrate with specialized international payment processors and handle complex multi-currency ledger arithmetic within the software.

meta.title: Manufacturing Software & MES | Anthovai
meta.description: Anthovai engineers manufacturing software including MES, ERP integrations, and supply chain tracking systems.

hero.h1: Manufacturing Software — Production, Supply Chain & MES Systems
hero.intro: Anthovai engineers manufacturing software including MES, ERP integrations, and supply chain tracking systems — built for real-time visibility and IoT-ready infrastructure.

s1.title: MES / ERP Integration
s1.desc: We bridge the gap between the shop floor and the top floor by integrating Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) directly with your enterprise ERP.

s2.title: Real-Time Production Tracking
s2.desc: Track every unit, batch, and metric in real-time. Our software provides absolute visibility into your production lifecycle.

s3.title: IoT-Ready Architecture
s3.desc: Our infrastructure is designed to ingest and process high-frequency telemetry data from thousands of industrial IoT sensors operating on the factory floor.

q1.a: A Manufacturing Execution System (MES) is software that monitors and controls the complex manufacturing systems and data flows on the factory floor.

q2.q: How do you handle factory downtime during implementation?
q2.a: We deploy systems in parallel (shadow mode) alongside your existing processes until full stability is verified, ensuring zero production downtime.

q3.q: Can your software predict machine failure?
q3.a: Yes. By analyzing IoT sensor data through integrated Machine Learning models, we provide predictive maintenance alerts before critical failures occur.

q4.q: Do you support barcode and RFID scanning?
q4.a: Our platforms natively integrate with industrial barcode and RFID hardware for seamless inventory and asset tracking.
